After succesfully capturing the facility, you will receive an MCV. Set up bases and destroy the Soviet base in the area with the help of the information that you got from the captured radar.

Objectives:

1. Capture the Soviet Radar 2. Build up bases and destroy all Soviet forces in the area
missions.title: [2] Freezing Offensive

missions.briefing:
We need to open another front to pressure Nod forces in Sarajevo. Assault the southern coast of Croatia and take the area under our control.

Nod has heavily fortified the coastal islands, but if we manage to break their defense here, we'll have an easier time moving inland and preventing Nod forces from getting supplied by naval routes.

Objective: Destroy all Nod forces.
missions.title: [2] Cracking the Shell

missions.briefing: Khalkis Island contains a large quantity of ore that we need. The Allies are well aware of our plans, and intend to establish their own base there. See to it that they fail.
missions.title: [2] Distant Thunder

missions.briefing:
We've gained intel that Nod is building new weapon technology in a Temple in this sector. Take two commandoes with special weaponry, sneak and kill your way to the Temple of Nod, and blow it up.

Destroy any Nod forces that are necessary to reach the Temple, but avoid needless violence. Nod will send in reinforcements after detecting you, so you won't have an endless amount of time.
missions.title: [2] Double Team

missions.briefing:
We've received information that GDI is in the process of building an air base on this area, near a larger existing GDI base. The air base is already functional, but GDI hasn't finished its defenses yet. This means that we have the perfect opportunity to strike.

Use a small strike force to attack a GDI radar facility, creating a distraction for GDI reinforcements. After that, capture the GDI air base along with GDI A-10 aircraft, and use the aircraft to bomb a nearby civilian shopping center.

With the local population furious towards GDI, taking out their whole base with our next attack is going to be easy!

Objectives:

1. Destroy a GDI radar facility to create a distraction for GDI reinforcements. 2. Secure the GDI air base. 3. Use GDI A-10 aircraft to destroy the shopping center. Avoid GDI anti-air defenses.
missions.title: [2] Disguised Manipulation

missions.briefing:
Our strike on the GDI air base was succesful. Not only did we destroy the air base, but the local civilians are now furious at GDI. They've taken up arms and are willing to assist us in taking out the rest of GDI forces in the area.

We've built two small outposts into the area. Take control of them and the armed civilians and destroy the GDI base in the north.
missions.title: [2] Forged Payback

missions.briefing:
Allied forces are close to Moscow. You will lead a heroic effort to repel the capitalist dogs that recently forced a crossing of a nearby river. Two MCVs were moved into the area in preparation for your counteroffensive, but counter-revolutionary saboteurs appear to have damaged our production. With all engineering assets deployed to other sectors of the Moscow defensive line, you will have to make do with limited capabilities.

The commander at position 1 has combat vehicle production, but lacks air assets and nukes. The commander at position 2 has air assets and nukes, but no combat vehicle production.

Objective: Destroy all Allied forces.
missions.title: [2] Schematic Scramble

missions.briefing:
A previously secure strait has been overrun by GDI forces and their local lackeys, who are still using old Allied equipment from the last war. As a result, one of the Inner Circle's laboratories is now in danger. One of our... less qualified battalions has moved in to establish a barrier between GDI and the lab, but the situation remains precarious.

The commander at position 1 will take command of the lab, and will be limited to high-tech units. The commander at position 2 will take command of the relief force, and will be limited to low-tech units.

Objective 1: Destroy all enemy forces.

Objective 2: The lab's Research Facility must survive.
missions.title: [2] Hybrid Warfare

Destroying the ant nests near our base wasn't enough. While we were busy eliminating the nests, more nests appeared near a city of ours. High-profile members of the Communist party live in the city, so we cannot allow the residents to get eaten.

We'll deploy forces near the city. Take control of them, build bases and defend the city center until we've rescued all civilians. Gassing ant nests is not necessary, but it could be helpful to reduce the number of attacking ants.

missions.briefing:
Nod is sieging our base. They've deployed SAM sites and ground forces, entirely preventing us from supplying the base with additional resources.

Use our reinforcements to break Nod's siege. Once you've broken the siege, we'll send you 2 extra MCVs. Build up additional bases and erase Nod forces from the area.

Objectives:

1. Use the GDI reinforcements to destroy Nod's sieging forces

2. Build up additional bases and destroy all Nod forces in the area
missions.title: [3] Ally Under Siege

missions.briefing: Nod has launched an attack with the aim to exterminate a civilian village under GDI protection. Hold off against the attack, prepare a force sufficient for a counter-attack and destroy Nod forces in the area.
missions.title: [3] Operation Barachiel

missions.briefing: The Soviets are about to launch a massive assault against our Chronosphere facility. Defend it at all costs until reinforcements arrive!
missions.title: [3] Freezingly Desperate Grip

missions.briefing:
Our previous attack against the Allied Chronosphere facility was a complete failure. By now the Allies have likely strengthened their defences significantly, but with the snow gone, our tanks are able to move faster as well!

Move in, build bases and obliterate the Allied Chronosphere facility and all of their bases for good.
missions.title: [3] Second Wind

missions.briefing:
GDI is finishing a large facility in this area that would significantly increase their ship production capabilities. We cannot let them do that. You need to attack the facility and destroy it.

GDI is expecting you, and they've reacted by starting to build a forward base to defend their main facility. Assault the forward base from three different directions. Once you're done with the forward base, you will receive MCVs. Build bases, strengthen your forces and sink the main facility.
missions.title: [3] The Anchoring

missions.briefing:
GDI is attacking our base by deploying heavy forces and several MCVs to the area. Crush them as they arrive.

Try to destroy the MCVs as quickly as possible to prevent GDI from building up bases and training more forces. The production capability of multiple functional GDI bases could prove to be overwhelming.

missions.briefing:
Our previous operation was not enough to eliminate the bunnies. Some of them had already spread to another area. To contain the swarm of bunnies we've blocked off all routes to the area, aside from one bridge that is under control of Nod forces. Destroy the bridge to prevent the bunnies from spreading further.

Once the bridge has been destroyed, we'll give you MCVs. Build bases and search and destroy all rabbit holes to erase the bunnies for good.

There is also a city in the area. We've gathered information that some of the civilians have started raising the bunnies as pets. Keep an eye out for them and eliminate the "pets", but avoid hurting the innocent.
missions.title: [3] Bunny Lockdown

missions.briefing:
GDI is using multiple bridge routes to send massive reinforcements into a strategically important island that we're just barely holding on to.

Reinforce the island, take out the bridges to prevent GDI reinforcements from arriving, and destroy the GDI bases on the island.
missions.title: [3] A Bridge Too Many

missions.title: [3] A Bridge Too Many

missions.briefing:
The Allies are relentlessly assaulting our Baltic comrades, calling it a "liberation". They have taken most of the city and installed radar posts to call for further reinforcements, and prepare their final assault on our fort and research facilities to the north. This city holds a lot of industry and is vital to the war effort!

One of you will take command of the fort and hold the line while your comrades begin an assault from the south. The Allies have destroyed all the bridges leading into the city, restore them and crush these "liberators"!
missions.title: [3] Liberation Extermination

missions.briefing:
The Allies are pushing on in our Soviet heartland! They have reached a large industrial zone that we cannot afford to lose. Defend it at all costs, with the power of the industry, an elite reinforcement group, as well as our nuclear forces! Use the fortified urban concentrations to help you in the defense.

Commander at position 1 controls the industrial zone. They have massively cheaper, but less effective units.

Commander at position 2 controls an elite reinforcement group. They have more effective but also more expensive units, as well as Armories for promoting their infantry to elite.

Commander at position 3 possesses three Nuke Silos, as well as aircraft and infantry production capabilities, and increased movement speed for their units.

Objective: Destroy all Allied forces.
missions.title: [3] Red Line

Our base on this area is nearly completely destroyed. Reinforce it with MCVs and experimental Railgun-based Mammoth tanks, and destroy all Nod forces in the area.

Expect heavy resistance. Nod has the entire area in their control with the help of their new stealth technology.
missions.title: [4] Cloaked Twilight

missions.briefing: Nod has set up a new Tiberium-based weapon development laboratory in this sector. Destroy it at all costs.
missions.title: [4] The Experiment Lab

missions.briefing:
